title: "Compensatory Advantage Explorer"
format: html
engine: knitr
filters:
  - shinylive
---

Explore how first-year academic performance and family educational background are associated with students' decisions to continue, transfer or leave university.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 670

library(shiny)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA
# Published predicted probabilities
# Sánchez-Gelabert & Troiano
# Appendix 2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat <- data.frame(

  performance = rep(seq(0, 100, 10), each = 3),

  family = rep(
    c(
      "Compulsory",
      "Post-compulsory",
      "University"
    ),
    11
  ),

  continuing = c(
    .132,.147,.168,
    .207,.226,.245,
    .308,.329,.342,
    .430,.451,.453,
    .561,.577,.567,
    .683,.692,.674,
    .783,.787,.764,
    .858,.857,.835,
    .910,.907,.887,
    .944,.940,.924,
    .965,.962,.950
  ),

  dropout = c(
    .599,.532,.445,
    .526,.453,.376,
    .440,.367,.304,
    .346,.278,.233,
    .254,.198,.169,
    .174,.132,.116,
    .112,.083,.076,
    .069,.050,.048,
    .041,.029,.030,
    .024,.017,.018,
    .014,.010,.011
  ),

  transfer = c(
    .269,.321,.387,
    .267,.321,.379,
    .252,.304,.354,
    .224,.271,.314,
    .186,.226,.264,
    .144,.176,.210,
    .105,.130,.159,
    .073,.092,.117,
    .049,.064,.083,
    .032,.043,.058,
    .021,.029,.040
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# UI
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ui <- fluidPage(

  tags$head(

    tags$style(
      HTML("

        body {
          font-family:
            system-ui,
            -apple-system,
            BlinkMacSystemFont,
            'Segoe UI',
            sans-serif;

          margin: 0;
          padding: 0;
        }

        .app-wrapper {
          max-width: 900px;
          margin: 0 auto;
          padding: 5px 10px 15px 10px;
        }

        .control-panel {
          padding: 14px;
          background: #f7f7f7;
          border-radius: 8px;
          margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .control-panel .form-group {
          margin-bottom: 13px;
        }

        .result-number {
          font-size: 24px;
          line-height: 1.15;
          font-weight: 600;
        }

        .result-label {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: #666;
          margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .result-box {
          padding: 10px;
          border: 1px solid #dddddd;
          border-radius: 7px;
          text-align: center;
          background: white;
          min-height: 65px;
        }

        .compare-section {
          margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .compare-section h4 {
          margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .compare-description {
          font-size: 13px;
          margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .compare-row {
          margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .compare-label {
          font-size: 12px;
          margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .compare-bar {
          display: flex;
          width: 100%;
          height: 23px;
          overflow: hidden;
          border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .legend {
          display: flex;
          gap: 18px;
          margin-top: 8px;
          font-size: 11px;
          color: #666;
        }

        .legend-item {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 5px;
        }

        .legend-box {
          width: 10px;
          height: 10px;
          border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .note {
          color: #666;
          font-size: 11px;
          line-height: 1.4;
          margin-top: 18px;
        }

      ")
    )
  ),


  div(

    class = "app-wrapper",


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Controls + main flow
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    fluidRow(

      column(

        width = 4,

        div(

          class = "control-panel",

          selectInput(
            inputId = "family",
            label = "Family educational level",
            choices = c(
              "Compulsory",
              "Post-compulsory",
              "University"
            ),
            selected = "Compulsory"
          ),

          sliderInput(
            inputId = "performance",
            label = "First-year performance (%)",
            min = 0,
            max = 100,
            value = 20,
            step = 10
          ),

          p(
            style = "
              font-size:11px;
              line-height:1.4;
              color:#666;
              margin-bottom:0;
            ",
            "Percentage of enrolled credits successfully completed during the first year."
          )

        )

      ),


      column(

        width = 8,

        uiOutput("flow")

      )

    ),


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Outcome boxes
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    fluidRow(

      column(

        width = 4,

        div(
          class = "result-box",

          div(
            "Continue",
            class = "result-label"
          ),

          div(
            textOutput("continue_value"),
            class = "result-number"
          )
        )

      ),


      column(

        width = 4,

        div(
          class = "result-box",

          div(
            "Drop out",
            class = "result-label"
          ),

          div(
            textOutput("dropout_value"),
            class = "result-number"
          )
        )

      ),


      column(

        width = 4,

        div(
          class = "result-box",

          div(
            "Transfer",
            class = "result-label"
          ),

          div(
            textOutput("transfer_value"),
            class = "result-number"
          )
        )

      )

    ),


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Comparison
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    div(

      class = "compare-section",

      h4("Compare family educational backgrounds"),

      p(
        class = "compare-description",

        "At the same level of academic performance, how are the three outcomes distributed across family educational backgrounds?"
      ),

      uiOutput("comparison"),

      div(

        class = "legend",

        div(
          class = "legend-item",
          div(
            class = "legend-box",
            style = "background:#4E79A7;"
          ),
          span("Continue")
        ),

        div(
          class = "legend-item",
          div(
            class = "legend-box",
            style = "background:#C95D5D;"
          ),
          span("Drop out")
        ),

        div(
          class = "legend-item",
          div(
            class = "legend-box",
            style = "background:#59A875;"
          ),
          span("Transfer")
        )

      )

    ),


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Source
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    div(

      class = "note",

      HTML(
        "<strong>Source:</strong> Sánchez-Gelabert, A. & Troiano, H.
        <em>Compensatory advantage after the first year at university
        in the Catalan system: between continuing, transferring and
        dropping out</em>. Predicted probabilities reported in
        Appendix 2.<br>
        Values are model-based predicted probabilities.
        The visualization does not represent causal effects."
      )

    )

  )

)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SERVER
# ------------------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {


  # Selected combination --------------------------------------

  selected <- reactive({

    dat[
      dat$performance == input$performance &
      dat$family == input$family,
    ]

  })


  # Numbers ----------------------------------------------------

  output$continue_value <- renderText({

    paste0(
      round(
        selected()$continuing * 100,
        1
      ),
      "%"
    )

  })


  output$dropout_value <- renderText({

    paste0(
      round(
        selected()$dropout * 100,
        1
      ),
      "%"
    )

  })


  output$transfer_value <- renderText({

    paste0(
      round(
        selected()$transfer * 100,
        1
      ),
      "%"
    )

  })


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Dynamic Sankey-like flow
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  output$flow <- renderUI({

    x <- selected()

    p1 <- x$continuing
    p2 <- x$dropout
    p3 <- x$transfer


    # Flow thickness

    width1 <- max(4, p1 * 60)
    width2 <- max(4, p2 * 60)
    width3 <- max(4, p3 * 60)


    html <- paste0(

      '<div style="
          width:100%;
          display:flex;
          justify-content:center;
          align-items:center;
        ">',


      '<svg
          viewBox="0 0 650 300"
          style="
            width:100%;
            max-width:620px;
            height:auto;
            display:block;
          ">',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Title
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<text
          x="20"
          y="20"
          font-size="13"
          font-weight="600"
          fill="#222222">',

      input$family,
      ' family education · ',
      input$performance,
      '% performance',

      '</text>',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Cohort box
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<rect
          x="25"
          y="112"
          width="125"
          height="76"
          rx="9"
          fill="#f5f5f5"
          stroke="#cccccc"/>',


      '<text
          x="87"
          y="137"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="10"
          fill="#666666">
          SELECTED GROUP
       </text>',


      '<text
          x="87"
          y="164"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="23"
          font-weight="600"
          fill="#222222">
          100
       </text>',


      '<text
          x="87"
          y="180"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="10"
          fill="#666666">
          students
       </text>',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Flows
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<path
          d="M150 140 C280 140, 330 63, 500 63"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#4E79A7"
          stroke-width="',
          width1,
          '"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          opacity="0.78"/>',


      '<path
          d="M150 150 C280 150, 330 150, 500 150"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#C95D5D"
          stroke-width="',
          width2,
          '"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          opacity="0.78"/>',


      '<path
          d="M150 160 C280 160, 330 237, 500 237"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#59A875"
          stroke-width="',
          width3,
          '"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          opacity="0.78"/>',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Continue box
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<rect
          x="500"
          y="33"
          width="125"
          height="60"
          rx="9"
          fill="white"
          stroke="#cccccc"/>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="57"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="12"
          fill="#444444">
          Continue
       </text>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="80"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="20"
          font-weight="600"
          fill="#222222">',

      round(p1 * 100, 1),

      '%</text>',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Dropout box
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<rect
          x="500"
          y="120"
          width="125"
          height="60"
          rx="9"
          fill="white"
          stroke="#cccccc"/>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="144"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="12"
          fill="#444444">
          Drop out
       </text>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="167"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="20"
          font-weight="600"
          fill="#222222">',

      round(p2 * 100, 1),

      '%</text>',


      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Transfer box
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      '<rect
          x="500"
          y="207"
          width="125"
          height="60"
          rx="9"
          fill="white"
          stroke="#cccccc"/>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="231"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="12"
          fill="#444444">
          Transfer
       </text>',


      '<text
          x="562"
          y="254"
          text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="20"
          font-weight="600"
          fill="#222222">',

      round(p3 * 100, 1),

      '%</text>',


      '</svg>',
      '</div>'

    )


    HTML(html)

  })


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Comparison between family educational backgrounds
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  output$comparison <- renderUI({

    temp <- dat[
      dat$performance == input$performance,
    ]


    rows <- lapply(

      seq_len(nrow(temp)),

      function(i) {

        r <- temp[i, ]


        tags$div(

          class = "compare-row",


          tags$div(

            r$family,

            class = "compare-label"

          ),


          tags$div(

            class = "compare-bar",


            tags$div(

              style = paste0(
                "width:",
                r$continuing * 100,
                "%;",
                "background:#4E79A7;"
              ),

              title = paste0(
                "Continue: ",
                round(
                  r$continuing * 100,
                  1
                ),
                "%"
              )

            ),


            tags$div(

              style = paste0(
                "width:",
                r$dropout * 100,
                "%;",
                "background:#C95D5D;"
              ),

              title = paste0(
                "Drop out: ",
                round(
                  r$dropout * 100,
                  1
                ),
                "%"
              )

            ),


            tags$div(

              style = paste0(
                "width:",
                r$transfer * 100,
                "%;",
                "background:#59A875;"
              ),

              title = paste0(
                "Transfer: ",
                round(
                  r$transfer * 100,
                  1
                ),
                "%"
              )

            )

          )

        )

      }

    )


    tagList(rows)

  })

}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# RUN APP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)
```
